verdict.rationale: Grok Bot's own docs show files can be sent into a chat via the iPhone share sheet. Its files-and-results page lists CSV, JSON, YAML, source-code files and Jupyter notebooks as handled formats, and Bots keep their files across sessions. However, nothing documents PDF or office-document handling, or the quality and accuracy of the analysis. Missing for 10: explicit PDF and document (e.g. Word) support, spreadsheet formats beyond CSV, documented analysis and accuracy behavior, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can upload documents, spreadsheets, and PDFs and get accurate analysis of their contents

citations.quote: CSV, JSON, YAML, and source-code files ... Jupyter notebooks
use the system share sheet and choose Grok Bot to send a photo, file, link, or text into a chat
A named Bot keeps its memory, files, browser sessions, and preferences across sessions
